question: was R34's overfitting caused by training on a single tape?

multi_vs_single.note: the 72-episode per-episode dev values were overwritten by an earlier run (see R34 limitations), so this is a mean-to-mean difference, not a bootstrap

limitations: one dev window (seed11) and n=10, same as R34, so the interval stays wide
the single-window policy had 72 episodes and the multi-window one 80; per-window that is 20 vs 72, so the comparison also changes episodes-per-window
multi-window training shares one 106-dim MLP across four bullet patterns; a bigger network could behave differently

verdict.reading: multi-window training recovers some of R34's loss but still does not beat uniform random on the held-out tape
